scope: Follow-up static concept screens 09 chapter, 11 friends and 13 archive. No gameplay code, live sharing, saving, collection deletion or implementation.

records.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one portrait mobile in-game chapter-completion screen for the original game 꿈손님 여관. This is a static concept screen, not a working app.
Input images: Image 1 is the reference world, palette and original character identities; Image 2 is the exact simple modular six-cell kit and prop reference. Use the mood and characters but reduce environment detail drastically to readable tiny mobile low-poly forms.
Create a complete single mobile app screen with ivory background, charcoal Korean sans typography, restrained teal primary button, generous spacing, no device bezel, no OS status bar. Consistent minimal rounded panels. Warm matte 3D illustration only inside the main scene. A small unobtrusive label "시안" at upper right.
Top navigation: small left chevron and text "꿈손님 여관".
Main large title exactly "1장 완성".
Below it, one centered clear isometric room cutaway, a modest SINGLE ground floor. Its floor is EXACTLY SIX visible equal square cells in THREE columns and TWO rows. Back row left-to-right: 모루, 이끼 가림막, 도담. Front row left-to-right: 루미, 등불, 온돌돌. The three tiny original friends are sage-and-cream fox 모루 with ONE broad tail; cream turtle 도담 with plain slate-teal shell; cream bean moth 루미 with broad amber wings. Tiny sleeping relaxed poses, not human, no clothes or fur. Moss privacy screen is a simple sage panel. Lamp is short with its own small flat circular foot sitting directly on the cell: absolutely NO table or stool. 온돌돌 is a plain low flat warm slate stone, not a bowl. No seventh tile, no second floor, no extra table. Six cells should occupy most of the scene and be easy to count.
Keep one little round wall window, warm pale timber, simple slate-teal roof edge and a tiny glimpse of the moonlit stream. Few big shapes, sparse leaves, no intricate foliage. Calm completion with no fireworks, no rewards.
Below the room, a small quiet next-story preview: folded ivory envelope by the same round window. Use heading "다음 이야기" and title exactly "창가에 남은 편지". No story paragraphs.
At bottom, two clearly differentiated actions: secondary outlined button exactly "일지로 돌아가기"; primary teal button exactly "다음 이야기". Both large touch-friendly size, no cramped tiny text.
Only the exact listed Korean text. No coins, currency, star ratings, level numbers other than 1장, streaks, timers, health numbers, hours, scores, sleep quality claim or congratulation about sleeping well. Never imply that resting or sleeping earned a score. No brands, copyrighted characters, watermark. This depicts story chapter completion only.
records.inspection: Portrait static screen; 1장 완성, 창가에 남은 편지, 일지로 돌아가기 and 다음 이야기 are visible. Main room has six cells with expected character/prop arrangement, direct-foot lamp, one fox tail and plain turtle shell. Marked 시안; no sleep evaluation, score or currency. Plants and stone scenery remain richer than the minimal production model target.

records.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: landscape board with exactly TWO portrait mobile screens side by side for original game 꿈손님 여관, asynchronous friend inns and shared postcard album. Static concept, no live transmission.
Input images: Image 1 is the UI language / inn world / ivory and teal reference. Image 2 is the strict original three-character identity reference. Preserve the style and identities, with sparse simple low-poly 3D miniatures, not a detailed city.
Composition: two equally sized tall mobile screen rectangles, generous ivory outer margin and central gutter, no device hardware, no browser or OS status bar. Soft ivory screen surface, charcoal highly legible Korean typography, restrained teal actions. Avoid excessive nested boxes. Outside the screens, small caption exactly "화면 시안 · 실제 전송 없음".
LEFT SCREEN: small back chevron; title "친구 여관" and small "예시" badge. One quiet friend inn postcard scene filling the upper half, showing a modest single-floor small inn and the three original friends together. 모루 is sage and cream fox with one broad tail, 도담 cream turtle with plain slate-teal shell, 루미 cream bean moth with broad amber wings. No people, no real names, no user photographs.
Below scene, heading "함께 모은 엽서". Two small postcard thumbnails side by side: left the three friends by round inn window, right same three by moonlit stream. No timestamps or counts. A full-width teal bottom action exactly "보낼 엽서 고르기". It is an invitation to select before sending, never a confirmation that anything was sent.
RIGHT SCREEN: small back chevron; title "엽서 미리보기" and small "예시" badge. Large preview of a SELECTED postcard of the same three friends under the same slate-teal inn roof by the stream. This is selected but unsent. No envelope flying or sent checkmark.
Below postcard, heading exactly "공유 범위". Two clearly visible mutually exclusive radio choices in fixed order: first "선택한 친구만" is selected with teal radio dot; second "공동 앨범" is unselected with empty radio circle. These are sharing destination examples, no names or account identifiers. Below them, full-width teal button exactly "보내기"; secondary understated text "다시 고르기".
Use only the listed Korean text. Large readable headings and labels, compact natural spacing. No sleep duration, sleep time, dates, health numbers, scores, streaks, punishment, coins, currency, rank, follower count, real identities, or private journal content. Do not show a successful send, delivery receipt, social notification or any live-data claim. Only example scenes with original characters. No copyrighted mascot, logos or watermark.
records.inspection: Two screens with 예시 tags; postcard-selection CTA precedes preview, sharing-scope radio choices and explicit 보내기. Bottom text states 화면 시안 · 실제 전송 없음. No real name, dates, sleep numbers or successful-send receipt. Original characters retain identity; small mouth dots appear in friendly scene illustrations. No live transmission occurred.

records.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: landscape board with exactly TWO portrait mobile screens for the original small game 꿈손님 여관. The five-chapter story has concluded; preserve the old inn as a postcard and choose a new journey with a fresh layout. Static concept screens.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact UI / typography scale / ivory and teal / visual art reference. Image 2 is the exact original character model identity reference. Maintain the same three characters, muted sage/cream/amber/slate-teal palette, matte low-poly forms and simple small inn, no busy city.
Composition: two equally sized portrait screen panels side by side with wide ivory central gutter, generous margins, no phone bezel, no browser or OS status bar. Warm ivory surface, charcoal legible Korean typography, teal primary CTA. One short caption below the two screens exactly "화면 시안". Do not depict this as a live saved state.
LEFT SCREEN — the end of the five-chapter story:
Small back chevron, top title "여관 엽서 보관함", small "예시" badge.
Below, the concise heading exactly "다섯 장의 이야기".
A LARGE featured postcard of the completed modest inn at dawn, the same three friends reunited on its small porch: sage/cream fox 모루 with ONE wide tail, cream turtle 도담 with a plain slate-teal shell, cream bean moth 루미 with broad amber wings. Quiet river, rounded trees, single small house and one roof, just one modest improvement, no multiple storeys or sprawling town.
Postcard title exactly "같은 지붕 아래".
Below, a compact row of five little chapter thumbnails: lamp, letter by round window, rainy eave, three friends with different seats, three reunited friends. No text within the tiny thumbnails, no scores or completion checkmarks.
A full-width outlined neutral action exactly "이 여관 보관하기". It is an available action, not a fake saved receipt.
RIGHT SCREEN — choose a fresh journey:
Small back chevron, top title exactly "새 여정", small "예시" badge.
Main heading exactly "새로운 배치".
A simple one-floor empty 3-by-2 inn layout with six clearly visible equal tiles, same architecture and slate-teal roof edge, an alternative wall/window arrangement from the left completed inn. No new species, collectibles or fancy decorations. Just the three familiar tiny friends standing together outside the board at its side.
Below the scene, one clear preservation note exactly "이전 여관과 도감은 그대로 남아요". This sentence must be fully visible and not truncated, and must mean the old saved inn and collection remain.
Below, two compact options with real-looking consistent radio circles: "숲가" selected with teal dot, "물가" unselected. Each option has a small simple environment thumbnail. This is choice of the NEW journey backdrop/layout, never deletion of the original.
At bottom, full-width teal primary button exactly "새 여정 시작", then secondary text exactly "보관함으로 돌아가기".
Only listed Korean text. Do not add reset, delete, erase, overwriting or loss warning. No coin cost, currencies, streaks, punishment, sleep data, hours, real names, health score, performance rewards or claim about sleeping well. No successful-save badge. No logos, watermark, brands, or copyrighted characters. This is a static visual proposal of preservation and a separate fresh arrangement, not data persistence proof.
records.inspection: Text and preservation note correct, but generator misinterpreted new 3x2 room as a two-storey structure. Rejected in favor of targeted geometry correction.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input images: Image 1 is the TWO-SCREEN ARCHIVE BOARD to edit. Image 2 is the EXACT EMPTY INN KIT reference and must be copied for its one-floor spatial geometry.
Make ONE targeted correction: replace ONLY the large inn model in the UPPER HALF OF THE RIGHT SCREEN, beneath "새로운 배치". It currently incorrectly has two storeys. Replace it with the SAME SINGLE-STOREY EMPTY ROOM shown at the upper left of Image 2.
The replacement has one FLAT HORIZONTAL FLOOR PLANE containing exactly SIX square cells: three columns from left to right, two rows from front to back. All six tiles lie at exactly the SAME HEIGHT. These are FLOOR TILES, NOT separate rooms, not six windows, and not two levels. Use a clear downward isometric camera so both front and rear tile rows are visible.
Copy the empty reference kit's geometry: three floor columns times two floor rows, low rear and side walls, ONE single circular window in rear wall. No second floor, NO upper deck, NO middle horizontal wall, no loft, no extra window row, no stair between floors. The entire six-cell floor should be completely empty.
Keep the three friends standing outside the front-right edge of the new flat room, unchanged identities. Retain modest surrounding scenery at the edge only. Do not put any character or prop into its empty six-cell floor.
Preserve absolutely ALL OTHER PARTS of Image 1: both screen frames, every Korean word exactly, all buttons, check/radio choices, five chapter postcards and left completed-inn picture, ivory/teal colors, composition, and typography. No new text or additional features. This is still a static concept mockup.
records.inspection: Right-hand new room corrected to one horizontal floor with six tiles, three columns and two rows. Five-chapter archive, 이 여관 보관하기, 새 여정 시작 and full 이전 여관과 도감은 그대로 남아요 note are visible. 예시 and 화면 시안 labels retained; no save success claim. Fourth tiny chapter thumbnail depicts shared seating rather than precise differing-seat layout; use 02-story.png for canonical chapter-scene detail. This image does not verify persistence.
